title: Netherese Enclave Collapse Sequence & Ooze Surge
source_reference: User-supplied Meeting 12 encounter handoff; no published-source citation supplied

hazards.name: Seismic Tremors
hazards.failure_effect: Knocked prone; any additional falling-debris damage is GM-adjudicated and not specified as automatic.

hazards.name: Hydrostatic Ooze Surge

damage.trigger: On contact or as defined by GM encounter rules; exact trigger unresolved

hazards.movement_penalty: Unspecified; must be defined before running encounter.
hazards.fluid_model: Fictional acidic non-Newtonian slime; parameters not calibrated

hazards.name: Arcane Null-Resonance
hazards.trigger: Casting a spell of 2nd level or higher
hazards.failure_effect: Wild magic fluctuation; exact effect selected by GM from an approved table.
hazards.notes: Alice's protected current Level 1 character cannot cast 2nd-level spells under normal class progression; hazard is not a current actionable penalty for her.

objectives.name: Structural Shutter
objectives.success: Stabilize lintels or valves and reduce structural danger.
objectives.failure: Collapse pressure persists; apply only a preapproved consequence.

objectives.name: Vector Calculation
objectives.success: Identify a safer route through shifting space.
objectives.failure: Use a longer or riskier route only if the GM has verified a route.

objectives.name: Disruption Vector
objectives.success: Resolve or redirect displaced subterranean entities through combat, negotiation, or environmental tactics.
objectives.failure: Entities remain an unresolved threat; exact consequences are GM-authored.

outcomes.label: Success
effects: A conditional safe-transit route may be reviewed
must_not_do: Do not unlock a route without geographic, historical, and player-authorization checks

outcomes.label: Partial Success
effects: Transit remains possible only after GM review
A delay, minor damage, or resource cost may be selected
must_not_do: Do not invent an operational route or automatic damage

outcomes.label: Failure
effects: A dangerous detour or temporary obstruction may be presented if supported by the encounter state
unresolved: Exhaustion implementation depends on chosen D&D edition and campaign rules
must_not_do: Do not automatically apply trauma, exhaustion, loss, or route lock to Alice's save

required_reviews: GM review of damage triggers and movement penalty
D&D edition/ruleset review of exhaustion and trauma
Player approval before encounter becomes active
